insurance_required.quote: It is unlawful for any advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife engaged in an independent practice of professional nursing or as a certified midwife to practice within the state of Colorado unless the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife purchases and maintains or is covered by professional liability insurance

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings.

value: Evaluating health status through collection and assessment of health data
Providing therapy and treatment supportive and restorative to life and well-being
Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions
Referring patients to medical or community agencies
Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans
Prescribing medications (for APRNs with prescriptive authority)
methods_authorized.quote: The "practice of professional nursing" includes the performance of such services as: Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data; Health teaching and health counseling; Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative to life and well-being either directly to the patient or indirectly through consultation with, delegation to, supervision of, or teaching of others; Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions; Referring to medical or community agencies those patients who need further evaluation or treatment; Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans.

drug_authority.value: APRNs with prescriptive authority may prescribe controlled substances and prescription drugs within their scope of practice and role/population focus; prescriptive authority requires board approval and mentorship. An APRN with prescriptive authority is subject to the 7-day opioid prescribing limit for new patients and electronic prescribing requirements for controlled substances.
drug_authority.quote: "Practice of advanced practice registered nursing" includes prescribing medications as may be authorized pursuant to section 12-255-112.
